Finnish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Proto-Finnic *patto.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈpɑtːo/, [ˈpɑ̝t̪ːo̞]
  • Rhymes: -ɑtːo
  • Syllabification(key): pat‧to
  • Hyphenation(key): pat‧to

Noun

[edit]

patto (dialectal)

  1. crime
  2. criminal

Italian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Latin pactum from pacisci (“to make an accordance”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈpat.to/
  • Rhymes: -atto
  • Hyphenation: pàt‧to

Noun

[edit]

patto m (plural patti)

  1. pact, agreement

Derived terms

[edit]
  • a patto di, a patto che
  • col patto di
  • patteggiare
  • patto col diavolo

Related terms

[edit]
  • pattizio

Further reading

[edit]
  • patto in Treccani.it – Vocabolario Treccani on line, Istituto dell'Enciclopedia Italiana

Anagrams

[edit]
  • potta

Pali

[edit]

[edit]
Alternative scripts
  • 𑀧𑀢𑁆𑀢𑁄 (Brahmi script)
  • पत्तो (Devanagari script)
  • পত্তো (Bengali script)
  • පත‍්තො (Sinhalese script)
  • ပတ္တော or ပတ္တေႃ or ပတ်တေႃ (Burmese script)
  • ปตฺโต or ปัตโต (Thai script)
  • ᨷᨲ᩠ᨲᩮᩣ (Tai Tham script)
  • ປຕ຺ໂຕ or ປັຕໂຕ (Lao script)
  • បត្តោ (Khmer script)
  • 𑄛𑄖𑄴𑄖𑄮 (Chakma script)

Noun

[edit]

patto

  1. nominative singular of patta (“bowl”)

Adjective

[edit]

patto

  1. masculine nominative singular of patta, which is past participle of pāpuṇāti (“to reach”)
